title: So, That's 7:30 on Thursday?
prerequisites: Recognise common days and clock times
observable_outcome: Repeat the booked day and time in a checking question, then respond to the confirmation.
learning_objective: Confirm a booking time by selecting the risky details, arranging a checking question, and producing a new confirmation.

scenario.prompt: Your shuttle is booked for Thursday at 7:30 a.m. Pick-up is at the east entrance.
scenario.problem: You think you heard the booking correctly. You want to check the day and time before ending the conversation.
scenario.model: So, that's 7:30 a.m. on Thursday, right?

language.grammar: A conversational check can use So, + that's + detail + right? A neutral full question can use Is that + detail? Use at with a clock time and on with a day when stating the arrangement.
language.meaning: The speaker repeats information they believe is correct and asks the listener to confirm it.
language.appropriateness: Right? is conversational and can sound more or less certain depending on intonation. Is that ...? is a neutral alternative when speaking to an unfamiliar person.
language.time_phrase: At 7:30 names the clock time. On Thursday names the day. In the checking question, 7:30 a.m. on Thursday keeps both details together.

choice_activity.prompt: Which sentence checks the booked day and time?

options.feedback: Yes. It repeats both risky details and asks for confirmation.
This usually asks for the current time. It does not repeat the booking details.
This keeps the day but loses the exact time, so the booking remains partly unchecked.

matching_activity.prompt: Match each booking detail to its role.

feedback.time: Thursday is not a clock time; it names the day.
feedback.place: Thursday is not a location; it names the day.

feedback.day: 7:30 a.m. is not a day; it is the clock time.
feedback.place: 7:30 a.m. is not a location; it names the time.

feedback.day: East entrance is not a day; it names the place.
feedback.time: East entrance is not a time; it names the place.
feedback.place: Correct. East entrance names the pick-up place.

chunks.feedback: Good start. So, links the check to what you just heard.
Correct. That's introduces the repeated booking details.
Correct. Keep the exact clock time.
Correct. Right? asks the listener to confirm.

arrange_activity.wrong_feedback: That chunk does not fit here yet. Look at the model and choose the next part.
arrange_activity.complete_feedback: Complete: So, that's 7:30 a.m. on Thursday, right?

transfer.situation: A clinic receptionist says: Your appointment is Monday at 2:15 p.m. in Room 4.
transfer.task: Say or write one sentence confirming the day and time. Add the room if useful.
acceptable_responses: So, that's 2:15 p.m. on Monday, right?
Did you say Monday at 2:15 p.m.?
So, Monday at 2:15 p.m. in Room 4, right?
rubric: I repeated the day and time.
Other clear checking questions can work.

review_prompt: Tomorrow, what can you say when you think you heard a booking time correctly but want to check it?

visual.alt_text: A four-step path from hearing a booking to confirming it: hear Thursday at 7:30, select the day and time, repeat the details, then ask right?
visual.text_equivalent: HEAR: Thursday at 7:30 -> SELECT: day plus time -> REPEAT: 7:30 on Thursday -> CHECK: right?

scenes.title: Hear
scenes.caption: Thursday at 7:30 a.m.
scenes.explanation: Listen for the booking details that could cause a missed journey.

scenes.title: Select
scenes.caption: DAY: Thursday / TIME: 7:30 a.m.
scenes.explanation: Choose the day and time as the risky details to confirm.

scenes.title: Arrange
scenes.caption: So, + that's + time + on + day + right?
scenes.explanation: Put the booking details inside a checking-question frame.

scenes.title: Check
scenes.caption: So, that's 7:30 a.m. on Thursday, right?
scenes.explanation: Repeat the exact details and invite confirmation.

scenes.title: Confirm
scenes.caption: Yes, Thursday at 7:30 a.m.
scenes.explanation: The listener confirms both details. The booking is now clear.

scenes.title: Transfer
scenes.caption: Monday at 2:15 p.m., Room 4
scenes.explanation: Use the same pattern with a clinic appointment.
